$description: CS2 theme content pack. Same keys as themes/classic.json. Words only; the app looks identical in every theme.
name: CS2
voice: HLTV-style caster hyping a Major final. Energetic, esports vocabulary (frag, clutch, ACE, eco, map, round), still teasing, never scolding. One drink = one frag.

comeback.criterion: Biggest bounce back after a quiet day
comeback.name: 0–12 Comeback

night_mvp.criterion: Most litres in a single day (one per day, shown in the replay)
night_mvp.name: Map MVP

metronome.name: Anchor
metronome.writeup: {perDay} L a day, every day, {days} days straight. Never top-fragged, never benched. You held the site while everyone else peeked.

chaos.name: Entry Fragger
chaos.writeup: First through the door, no utility, no plan. Quiet rounds, then a 2 a.m. shot out of nowhere. Nobody could read you. Including you.

connoisseur.behaviour: Rates a lot, wine and cocktails, premium drinks
connoisseur.name: IGL
connoisseur.writeup: {ratings} ratings and a call for every round. You didn’t just drink the trip; you ran the strats.

explorer.name: Lurker
explorer.writeup: {unique} different drinks. Always off on your own angle of the menu, showing up somewhere nobody checked.

tortoise.name: Clutch Master
tortoise.writeup: Slow rounds, last one alive. When everyone else was dead by midnight, you were still in the server, closing it out.

speedrunner.name: Rusher
speedrunner.writeup: Rush B, every night. Three drinks before the menus landed, eliminated before dessert. No regrets, no economy.

designated.name: Support
designated.writeup: {softShare}% of your drinks were soft. You threw the flashes, dropped the weapons, and got everyone home. Unsung. Essential.

loyalist.name: One-Tap Andy
loyalist.writeup: {topDrink}, {topCount} times. Same crosshair, same angle, same drink. Why change a meta that works?

night_owl.name: Night Shift
night_owl.writeup: {afterMidnight}% of your frags came after midnight. You only queue once the lobby empties.

social.behaviour: Most venues and most drinks logged at the same time as others
social.name: Rifler
social.writeup: {venues} maps and {cheers} trades with the squad. Always in the fight, never playing alone.

ranks.basis: Std drinks per day of the trip, split into 18 equal steps of 0.85 across the same 0–15+ range as Classic. Placeholder bands.

ready.title: Your match report is in.
ready.body: Watch yours now. The grand final goes live when {owner} hits play.
